Draw a compact horizontal bar plot with consistent bar geometry

booleplot.Rd

A horizontal count bar plot whose bar thickness is a fixed multiple of the label text height, so the graphic reads the same regardless of how many categories it has (two-value flags no longer render as fat slabs). Category names sit in the left margin; each bar is labelled to its right with its count and share (e.g. `22.6K (90.4 table travels inside the plot. Categories are sorted largest-to-smallest with the missing (`NA`) category always pushed last and drawn as a light bar with a steel-blue outline, so missingness reads as a gap rather than a value.

Usage

booleplot(
  x,
  bar_text_ratio = 2,
  gap_ratio = 1/3,
  bar_col = "steelblue",
  na_col = "#d7e0e8",
  na_border = "steelblue",
  na_lty = 1,
  na_lwd = 1.3,
  na_label = "NA",
  cex.names = 1.8,
  cex.value = 1.4,
  value_col = "gray30",
  x_pad = 0.03,
  plot_height_inches = NULL,
  mar = c(0, 6, 0, 1.5),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A named numeric vector (or one-way `table`) of non-negative counts; the names are the category labels.

bar_text_ratio

Target bar thickness as a multiple of the label text height. Defaults to `3`.

gap_ratio

Gap between bars as a fraction of bar height. Defaults to `1/3`.

bar_col

Fill for ordinary bars. Defaults to `"steelblue"`.

na_col, na_border, na_lty, na_lwd

Fill, border colour, line type and line width for the missing (`NA`) bar.

na_label

The label treated as the missing category. Defaults to `"NA"`.

cex.names, cex.value

Text scaling for the category names (left) and the count/share labels (right).

value_col

Colour of the count/share labels. Defaults to `"gray30"`.

x_pad

Fractional padding added past the longest bar. Defaults to `0.03`.

plot_height_inches

Device plot height used to size the bars. Defaults to the actual device height (`par("pin")[2]`), which is what keeps the bar thickness consistent across variables.

mar

Plot margins (bottom, left, top, right). The left margin holds the category names. Defaults to `c(0, 4.5, 0, 0.5)`.

...

Passed to [graphics::rect()].

Value

Invisibly, a list describing the geometry actually used.
